correctness.rationale: Distinct nonzero columns encode a spanning S⊂F_2^5\{0}, whose coordinate automorphisms are exactly GL(5,2) set stabilizers. Below length 9, |GL(5,2)|=9,999,360 exceeds binomial(31,8)=7,888,725; rank-deficient sets admit pointwise-fixing nonidentity elements. For n=9,10,11 every spanning S is equivalent to one containing the five standard basis columns: 14,950, 65,780 and 230,230 choices, exhaustively tested by compiled verify_lower.cpp and an independent review of its sound pruning; each has nontrivial stabilizer. Independent all-basis-image witness checking gives stabilizer one for nested sets of sizes 12–15; complements among 31 nonzero columns give sizes 16–19 and prove nonexistence for n≥20. Direct code paths verify_lower.cpp and verify_spectrum.py were inspected; lower checker recompiled and rerun: 0 rigid cases at n=9,10,11. No timeouts or random sampling.
residual_risks: Only fixed dimension five, full-support codes; allowing zero coordinates invalidates the upper length endpoint.
